relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, a statistically significant positive correlation between pain and VEGF was demonstrated.

relationships.subject: IL-1b
relationships.evidence_quote: Most studies agree that IL-1b is directly positively correlated to the degree of pain in patients with RC tendinopathy

relationships.subject: TNF-a
relationships.evidence_quote: therefore an association between TNF-a and pain-related sleep disturbance in patients with RC tear was demonstrated

key_findings: Subacromial bursa IL-1b and VEGF positively correlate with rotator cuff pain; TNF-a is linked to pain-related sleep disturbance.
MMP-1 and MMP-13 were not directly correlated with pain but were higher in massive full-thickness tears.
